description.value: Commercial resort on Spahats Creek Forest Service Road at the gateway to Wells Gray Provincial Park, directly across from Spahats Falls Day Use Area, with serviced and unserviced sites, showers, laundry, and Wi-Fi; a natural basecamp for the park's waterfalls and Trophy Mountain flower meadows, but the FSR approach means a rough ride in with loaded bags.

address.value: 988 Spahats Creek Forest Service Rd, Clearwater, BC V0E 1N1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and provides strong evidence for most fields. The contact page confirms address (988 Spahats Creek Forest Service Rd, Clearwater, BC V0E 1N1) and phone (250-674-8362), which are absent from OSM tags. Amenity evidence comes from the FAQ page ('laundry facilities'), the camping/RV page ('30-amp power, water hookups, internet'), the contact page (Wi-Fi confirmed), and a guest review mentioning 'showers' and an on-site German bakery. No explicit mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, animal-safe storage, pump, tools, fuel, or cyclist discount was found.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone number; both are confirmed on the website (988 Spahats Creek Forest Service Rd, Clearwater, BC V0E 1N1; 250-674-8362) and should be added to OSM.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operating private campground on a major touring corridor between Kamloops and Jasper, with confirmed showers, laundry, power hookups, Wi-Fi, and reservations — clearly valuable to touring cyclists passing through the Wells Gray area.
